summary: Novo Nordisk filed a Form 6-K disclosing ongoing share repurchases under a pre-announced program. The company repurchased B shares up to DKK 11.2 billion from May 6, 2026 to February 1, 2027, as part of a larger DKK 15 billion 12-month program beginning February 4, 2026. Weekly transactions averaged DKK 60 million at prices around DKK 298-309 per share. As of August 14, 2026, the company had repurchased 28.88 million B shares at an average price of DKK 279.80, totaling DKK 8.08 billion. Treasury shares now represent 1.0% of share capital. This is a routine capital return update for a European issuer, analogous to a US open-market buyback disclosure. Watch for pace of remaining purchases and any program execution changes.
